Q: Scroll Column with large height child in Flutter A:

If you want the third widget to expand and take the remaining space :

CustomScrollView(
  slivers: [
    SliverToBoxAdapter(child: widget1),
    SliverToBoxAdapter(child: widget2),
    SliverFillRemaining(
      hasScrollBody: true,
      child: widget3,
    ),
  ],
)

If you do NOT want the third widget to expand and just want everything to scroll naturally:

SingleChildScrollView(
  child: Column(
    children: [
      widget1,
      widget2,
      widget3,
    ],
  ),
)

//--------------> or<------------------
ListView(
  children: [
    widget1,
    widget2,
    widget3,
  ],
)

Q: Enterprise SSO implementation for a company A:

You can implement enterprise SSO by connecting your customer's IAM providers (Okta, Entra, Ping, etc.).

You can try to use open source solution like keyclock or SaaS solution like auth0, workos, ssojet, etc.

Q: In Ada using an enumeration type variable/instance as loop index in loop with case of each enumeration value A:

I am still unclear what you are trying to achieve. Yes you can use a case statement to respond to the value of a variable of your enumeration type. You might benefit from the online Ada tutorial at https://learn.adacore.com/courses/intro-to-ada/index.html

case rule is
   when row => -- perform row behavior here
   when col => -- perform col behavior here
   when cube => -- perform cube behavior here
end case;

Q: What is the difference between Firebase auth and Auth0 authentication A:

Auth0 is more focused on enterprise-style auth (OIDC/OAuth, SAML, RBAC, enterprise IdPs), while Firebase Auth is simpler and tightly integrated with the Firebase/Google ecosystem.

On Free or lower-tier plans, Auth0 offers things Firebase doesn’t handle as well, like more flexible OAuth/OIDC flows and limited SAML/enterprise SSO. Firebase shines for quick setup with phone/email/social login.

If you mainly need passwordless or OTP-based auth without enterprise complexity, tools like MojoAuth are also worth looking at.
